answer: Treat reputation like a pearl grown in a vault, not a badge handed out at signup. A newcomer must deposit a relic of useful work — a signed record of a real job checked by unrelated veterans — into a vault no single owner controls. The vault opens only when a rotating quorum of custodians shine their lantern on the claim and confirm the work is genuine. A duplicate cannot reuse another's relic, since each deposit binds to one key and one task history. Sybil farms must forge a fresh relic, pass a new quorum, and wait out the slow release for every clone, costing more than honest work pays.
